description: A React functional component implementing a SignIn form for a web application, handling user input, validation, and sign-in logic.

classes.name: Props
classes.description: TypeScript type defining the props for the SignIn component, including viewControllerManager and application objects.

methods.name: handleEmailChange
methods.description: Handles changes to the email input field, updating state and resetting validation error.

methods.name: handlePasswordChange
methods.description: Handles changes to the password input field, updating state and resetting validation error.

methods.name: handleCreateAccountInstead
methods.description: Triggers the transition to the create account pane if not currently signing in.

methods.name: handleSignIn
methods.description: Main sign-in handler; performs validation, calls the signIn method, and handles success/error outcomes.
